PanelDescription.SourceString: 附近的蛋糕店似乎有试吃活动，尝尝看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Looks like the nearby bakery is offering free samples. Why not give them a try?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 真是美味的蛋糕，问问店主能不能再买些吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: That cake was delicious! Let's ask the shop owner if we can buy some more!

Description.LocalizedString: Wait until the next afternoon <blue>(04:00 PM - 08:00 PM)</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 品尝到了美味的蛋糕，今天就先回去休息吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After tasting that delicious cake, let's head back and rest.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 收到了异象出现的通知，查看一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I received a notification about an Anomaly appearing. Let's check it out.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店里的现状似乎跟自己想的不同，去店里一探究竟吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The situation at the shop seems different than expected. Let's investigate.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店里的客人不仅没少反而变多了，是因为「苦蛋糕」吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Not only have the customers not decreased, but there are actually more of them! Is it because of this "Bittercake" Anomaly?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 菈比最近总是一副心事重重的样子，跟她聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Rabi has seemed really troubled lately. Let's talk to Rabi.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait until the next afternoon <blue>(04:00 PM - 08:00 PM)</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 了解到了有关「苦蛋糕」的事情，还帮助菈比解开了心结，今天就先休息吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After learning about Bittercake and helping Rabi work through her troubles, maybe it's time to rest for now.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 袋先生似乎发布了有关「苦蛋糕」的最新信息……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It looks like Mr. Bag has posted the latest info about Bittercake…

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>K110203_QuestPanel
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: K110203_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: 既然菈比邀请了，就去爱丽丝烘焙坊一趟吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Since Rabi invited me, I should pay a visit to Alice's Bakery.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 爱丽丝好像在等谁……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Alice seems to be waiting for someone…

PanelDescription.SourceString: K110206_QuestPanel
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: K110206_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: 天天乐呵呵的菈比也会有不愉快的时候，去店里看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Even the always cheerful Rabi has moments of negativity. I should go to the shop and see what's up.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 菈比看起来气鼓鼓的……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Rabi looks all puffed up with anger…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 爱丽丝还在坚持她的蛋糕试吃计划，去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Alice is still carrying on with her cake sampling plan. Let's go check it out.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「苦蛋糕」还没被泯除吗……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Bittercake still hasn't been nullified…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 再去店里看看吧……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let's go back and take another look…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 爱丽丝还在坚持她的蛋糕试吃计划，去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Alice is still carrying on with her cake sampling plan. Let's go check it out.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 答应了爱丽丝一起做蛋糕的要求，先问问菈比需要准备什么材料吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I agreed to make a cake with Alice. I should ask Rabi what ingredients we need to prepare.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「袋先生Tips」似乎发表了新的公告……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems Mr. Bag's Tips has published a new announcement…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去附近的「Myosotis」购买「泡沫幻境」吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Head to Myosotis nearby and buy some Bubbly Paradise strawberries.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到了「Myosotis」，不过店主看起来有些心事……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've arrived at Myosotis, but the owner seems to have something on their mind…

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the Anomaly sighting location

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去异象作祟的地方看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's check out the area affected by the Anomaly.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 现场有一名J.T.F成员，向他了解些情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's a JTF member at the scene. Talk to him for details.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 泯除这群捣乱的异象吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nullify these troublemaking Anomalies!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 成功泯除了现场的异象，跟现场的J.T.F汇报下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nullified the Anomalies at the scene. I should report back to the JTF member there.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 搞定了「泡沫幻境」，回店里吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Got the Bubbly Paradise, time to head back to the shop.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 菈比看起来等了很久的样子……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Rabi looks like she's been waiting for a long time…

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>K110219_QuestPanel
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: K110219_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>K110220_QuestPanel
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: K110220_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「粉红美梦」终于做好了，尝尝看吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Pinkish Dream is finally ready! Have a taste!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 忙碌了一天，回伊波恩休息一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's been a busy day. Let's head back to Eibon and get some rest.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 袋先生又发了新的通知……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mr. Bag posted another announcement…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 闭店……异象的影响这么严重吗……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Closed… Is the anomaly's influence really this severe…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 去店里看看吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let's head to the shop.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 似乎有异象在爱丽丝烘焙坊爆发了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Looks like an Anomaly has burst out at Alice's Bakery…

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>K110223_QuestPanel
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: K110223_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去店里看看吧，希望没什么大碍……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I should go check on the shop. Hopefully nothing serious has happened…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在被封禁的店门口遇到了熟悉的J.T.F成员，向他了解下情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I spotted a familiar JTF member at the sealed shop entrance. I should talk to them to find out what's going on.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 另一边菈比跟尾巴上「幽灵」的搏斗似乎也告一段落了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Meanwhile, Rabi seems to have finished its battle with the "ghost" on its tail…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去后厨看看爱丽丝的情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's go to the kitchen and check on Alice.

Description.LocalizedString: Discuss on how to help Rabi

PanelDescription.SourceString: 陪爱丽丝一起去问问J.T.F有没有新线索吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's accompany Alice to ask the JTF if they have any new clues.

PanelDescription.SourceString: J.T.F同意了我们参与泯除异象的请求，先收集下线索吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: JTF has approved our request to participate in nullifying the Anomaly. Let's collect some clues first.

PanelDescription.SourceString: J.T.F那里可能会有更多与「幽灵们的蛋糕盛宴」相关的线索……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: JTF might have more clues about the "Ghastly Cakefest"…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 直接问一下「幽灵」先生没准也会有帮助……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Maybe asking Mr. Ghost nicely could also help…

Description.LocalizedString: Find the key to the problem

PanelDescription.SourceString: 整理下收集到的线索，找出解决问题的关键吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's go over the clues we've collected and find the key to solving this problem!

Description.SourceString: 将思考的结果告诉<blue>爱丽丝</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将得出的结论告诉一旁担忧的爱丽丝吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Share your conclusions with the worried Alice beside you.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟「Myosotis」的店主聊一聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's have a chat with the Myosotis owner.

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>K110230_QuestPanel
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: K110230_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: 带回了「泡沫幻境」，帮菈比摆脱「幽灵」先生的困扰吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've brought the Bubbly Paradise back. Now I need to help Rabi get rid of Mr. Ghost and his troublemaking.

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>K110232_QuestPanel
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: K110232_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>K110233_QuestPanel
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: K110233_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: 耐心等待「粉红美梦」的完成吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wait patiently for the Pinkish Dream to be completed.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「粉红美梦」做好了，快去解救菈比吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Pinkish Dream is ready! Now, go rescue Rabi.

Description.SourceString: 将做好的蛋糕喂给<blue>「幽灵们的蛋糕盛宴」</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来「幽灵」先生也迫不及待了，快让它尝尝「粉红美梦」吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It looks like Mr. Ghost is getting impatient. Quick, let him taste the Pinkish Dream.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 菈比扭扭捏捏的，似乎有什么想说的……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Rabi is fidgeting, seems like it has something to say…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不远处有一只会说话的歧骸，过去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's a talking Oddity not far away. Let's go take a look.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 汪姿势怎样？是不是很有汪范？！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: How's this pose? Got a whole lot of Dawgster, no?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 给<blue>里尔</>拍张照片吧，记得要将它放在c位！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Take a photo of <blue>Ruddy</>, and make sure it's in the center!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 把拍好的照片给<blue>里尔</>看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Show the photo to <blue>Ruddy</>.

QuestName.SourceString: <!>【移动】前往叮咚怪咖所（不要了）
QuestName.LocalizedString: [Move] Go to Dingdong Weirdos Cafe (No need)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去<blue>叮咚怪咖所</>找<blue>里尔</>吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Jingle Wrangle</> to find <blue>Ruddy</>.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the ad shoot location

PanelDescription.SourceString: 下午三点的时候，去<blue>叮咚怪咖所</>找<blue>里尔</>吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: At 3 PM, go to <blue>Jingle Wrangle</> to find <blue>Ruddy</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>里尔</>似乎遇到了麻烦，去问问它吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: <blue>Ruddy</> seems to be in trouble. Let's go ask about it.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 进入<blue>叮咚怪咖所</>，向<blue>店长</>询问情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Enter <blue>Jingle Wrangle</> and ask the <blue>Owner</> about the situation.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （里尔跑远了，还是去找找他吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Ruddy ran away. Better go find him.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （他似乎受了很大打击，不知道现在怎么样了。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Seems like it hit him hard. I wonder how he is now.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>里尔</>看起来很沮丧，追上去看看他的情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: <blue>Ruddy</> looks dejected. Let's catch up and see how he's doing.

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>里尔</>似乎很难过，试着鼓励它振作起来！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: <blue>Ruddy</> seems very sad. Try to encourage him to cheer up!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 接受邀请，去拜访一下<blue>里尔的家</>吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Accept the invitation and visit <blue>Ruddy's home</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和<blue>里尔</>聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Chat with <blue>Ruddy</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 翻阅一下周围的照片吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Take a look at the photos around here.

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>里尔</>似乎很喜欢拍照，问问它还有没有别的照片吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: <blue>Ruddy</> seems to really enjoy taking photos. Let's ask if it has any other pictures.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 帮<blue>里尔</>找找以前的照片吧。或许箱子会有值得注意的线索？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Help <blue>Ruddy</> look for old photos. Maybe the boxes will have some noteworthy clues?

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>里尔</>辨认出了照片窃贼的身份……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: <blue>Ruddy</> has identified the photo thief…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随<blue>里尔</>的指引追踪<blue>团三郎</>吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow <blue>Ruddy</>'s guidance to track <blue>Danzaburou</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>里尔</>的步伐停下了，与它商议接下来怎么办吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: <blue>Ruddy</> has stopped walking. Let's discuss what to do next.

Description.SourceString: 向<blue>争执的情侣</>打听情况

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先向周围的人打听一下情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's ask the people around here about the situation first.

Description.SourceString: 寻找追逐「团三郎」的<blue>「凶狗」</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 按照热心市民提供的线索，去寻找追逐团三郎的<blue>「凶狗」</>吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Following the clues provided by helpful citizens, let's go find the <blue>dangerous dog</> chasing Danzaburou.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向「凶狗」<blue>奥尔</>询问情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's ask the "dangerous dog" <blue>Auddy</> about the situation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 团三郎躲进了垃圾桶，只能在附近的垃圾桶里找找了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Danzaburou hid in a trash can… We should search through the nearby ones.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （快跟上奥尔！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Hurry and follow Auddy!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （你好慢啊……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (You're so slow…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟上<blue>奥尔</>，沿着爆米花的踪迹追踪团三郎吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow <blue>Auddy</> and track Danzaburou along the popcorn trail.

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>奥尔</>似乎发现了什么，去山脚与它汇合吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: <blue>Auddy</> seems to have discovered something. Let's meet up with it at the foot of the mountain.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 或许把团三郎的储备粮挪走，就能引它现身……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Maybe if we move Danzaburou's food reserves, we can get it to come out…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 团三郎果然现身了，它变成了其他歧骸的模样，小心应对！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Danzaburou has finally appeared! It's transformed to look like other Oddities, so be careful!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将变身的<blue>「团三郎」</>击败！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Defeat the transformed <blue>Danzaburou</>!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将团三郎移交给赶到的<blue>J.T.F队员</>吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hand over Danzaburou to the <blue>JTF Member</> who arrived.

QuestName.LocalizedString: [Waiting] Ort Tips' attempt to retain you (No need).

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: K110327_QuestPanel

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和<blue>奥尔</>聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Chat with <blue>Auddy</>.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （拿到照片了，去之前约定的地点找里尔吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Got the photo. Time to head over to where Ruddy and I agreed to meet.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去之前约定的地点和<blue>里尔</>汇合吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to the previously agreed location and meet up with <blue>Ruddy</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将重新寻回的照片交给<blue>里尔</>吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Give the recovered photo to <blue>Ruddy</>.

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: K110331_QuestPanel

QuestName.LocalizedString: Go to the Hot Dog Stand

Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the <blue>Hot Dog Stand Owner</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去<blue>热狗摊</>看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Check out the <blue>hot dog stand</>.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这家热汪店超级好吃，汪和奥尔、布尔都超级喜欢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: This Hot Dawg shop is super good. Me, Auddy, and Buddy all love it.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 最可恶的是奥尔那家伙吃完他的热汪后，总是喜欢把头伸过来，抢汪的热汪！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Auddy would always try to steal a bite of my Hot Dawg when he finished eating his. Really can't stand him!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 布尔总是能很轻易记住吃热汪的时候，对面马路上究竟跑过多少辆车，有时候不得不羡慕啊。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Buddy could always recall how many cars passed on the road across when eating Hot Dawgs. Can't say I wasn't jealous.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟着<blue>里尔</>去它口中的好地方坐坐吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow <blue>Ruddy</> to the nice place it mentioned and have a seat.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 品尝一下热狗吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taste the hot dog.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一边享用热狗，一边和<blue>里尔</>聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Enjoy the hot dog while chatting with <blue>Ruddy</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去<blue>附近的公园</>寻找<blue>布尔</>吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>nearby park</> to find <blue>Buddy</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 试着把电影票交给<blue>布尔</>吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Try giving the Movie Ticket to <blue>Buddy</>.

Description.SourceString: 等待电影上映（<blue>第二天14点-22点</>）
Description.LocalizedString: Wait for the movie to start (<blue>Next day, 14:00 - 22:00</>)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （不知道他们究竟能不能和好……明天去电影院看看吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I wonder if they can reconcile… Let's try going to the cinema tomorrow.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等待明天电影上映……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wait for tomorrow's movie premiere…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 电影上映的时间到了，去<blue>露天影院</>看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's time for the movie to start! Check out the <blue>drive-in theater</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>三只狗</>聚在了一起，和它们聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The <blue>three dogs</> have gathered together. Chat with them.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随三只狗一同寻找<blue>「灵魂提取器」</>吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow the three dogs to find the <blue>Soultractor</>.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait for the dogs to dig

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （不见了！之前还在这里……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (It's gone! It was here before…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 会不会丢在某个角落里？再仔细看看。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We gotta leave no stone unturned.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等待它们寻找到「灵魂提取器」……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wait for them to find the Soultractor…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 找到了，在这里。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Found it. It's here.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和<blue>三只狗</>聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Chat with the <blue>three dogs</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向狗狗们演示「灵魂提取器」的正确用法……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Demonstrate the proper use of the Soultractor to the dogs…

Description.LocalizedString: Listen to the true feelings of <blue>the Dogs</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「灵魂提取器」并没有实现预想的效果，听听<blue>三只狗</>想要说什么吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Soultractor didn't achieve the expected results. Let's hear what the <blue>three dogs</> want to say.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 三只狗发生了变化……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The three dogs have changed…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和重归一体的<blue>奥布里</>聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Chat with <blue>Aubury</>, who has been reunited as one.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往<blue>照相馆</>和<blue>奥布里</>一起拍张合照吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Photo Studio</> and take a photo together with <blue>Aubury</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和<blue>柯达</>聊聊，或许能有优惠？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Chat with <blue>Kodak</>. Maybe you can get a discount?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往二楼的影棚区域，与奥布里会合吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Head to the studio area on the second floor and meet up with Aubury.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往<blue>二楼</>，去和<blue>奥布里</>合照吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>second floor</> and take a photo with <blue>Aubury</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与<blue>奥布里</>道个别吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Say goodbye to <blue>Aubury</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>返回大世界
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Return to the Big World

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不远处似乎有个熟悉的身影……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A familiar figure over there…

Description.LocalizedString: Take a photo from the left of <blue>Aubury</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 街边遇到的薯条兽似乎非常沮丧……问问它情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Frizzle I met on the street seems really dejected… I should ask what's wrong.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薯条兽迫不及待地冲出门寻找调查对象了，必须快点追上去。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Frizzle eagerly rushed out the door to find investigation subjects. I need to hurry and catch up.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随薯条兽，向调查对象进发！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow Frizzle and head toward the investigation targets!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （薯条兽，昨天把薯条给了那个人类！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Frizzle gave fries to that human yesterday!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随薯条兽来到了白鲸书店。这位店员似乎正是昨天收下了薯条的人……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I followed Frizzle to Moby-Dick Bookstore. This staff member seems to be the one who took the french fries yesterday…

Description.SourceString: 建议<blue>薯条兽</>更换调查对象

PanelDescription.SourceString: 白鲸书店的店员小姐似乎很忙。还是建议薯条兽寻找下一个调查对象吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The staff at Moby-Dick Bookstore seems really busy. I should suggest Frizzle find another investigation target.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薯条兽立刻开始寻找下一个调查对象，跟上去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Frizzle immediately starts looking for the next investigation target. Let's follow and see what happens.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （又找到了，领取薯条的人类！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Found another human who took my fries!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薯条兽在路边找到了曾收下薯条的外卖员，希望这次可以顺利取得调查结果……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Frizzle found the deliveryman who received the french fries on the roadside. Hopefully this time we can get some survey results…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 接连被拒绝两次，薯条兽垂头丧气。这样下去，就要与想要它打起精神的初衷背道而驰了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After being rejected twice in a row, Frizzle is feeling dejected. If this keeps up, it's going to defeat the whole purpose of trying to cheer it up…

Description.SourceString: 询问<blue>老夫妇</>的食用感想
Description.LocalizedString: Ask the <blue>elderly couple</> about their eating experience

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薯条兽受到打击而畏缩不前，代它去询问一下街边老夫妇的感想吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Frizzle has been discouraged and is too hesitant to continue. Let's go ask the elderly couple on the street about their thoughts instead.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 老夫妇似乎十分满意薯条兽的薯条。薯条兽一定想听到这个回答，为此，先去找它吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The elderly couple seems very satisfied with Frizzle's french fries. Frizzle will definitely want to hear this response! Let's tell it the good news.

Description.SourceString: 向<blue>薯条兽</>转述调查结果

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在不远处发现了薯条兽！快把这个好消息转告它吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Found Frizzle not far away! Let's quickly share the good news with it.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （听刚刚那对老夫妻的说法，薯条兽的薯条味道确实很不错……有点想尝尝了。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (From what that elderly couple just said, the Frizzle's french fries really do taste great… I'm kind of curious to try them now.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （希望薯条兽能从下一个调查对象那里，收到温柔的回复。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I hope Fry Beast gets a gentle response from their next investigation target.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薯条兽总算打起精神了。再寻找一个调查对象，让它彻底安心吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Frizzle finally perked up. Let's find one more investigation target to put it completely at ease.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一位女士突然叫住了薯条兽。她似乎有些话想说……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A woman suddenly called out to Frizzle. She seems to have something she wants to say…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薯条兽好像有些困惑……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Frizzle seems a bit confused…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （……薯条兽突然停下了。出什么事了？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (…Frizzle suddenly stopped. What happened?)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薯条兽似乎还想继续调查。事已至此，也只能帮歧骸帮到底了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Frizzle seems to want to keep investigating. Things have come this far, so I might as well help this Oddity see things through to the end…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （抢走薯条，大坏蛋！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Stealing fries, big meanie!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （薯条兽，一定要抓住它！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Frizzle will catch it for sure!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （……现在也只有跟上薯条兽了。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (…I guess I'd better follow the Frizzle for now.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 得知团三郎抢走了自己的薯条后，薯条兽生气地跑开了。不论如何，跟上去看看情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After learning that Danzaburou had stolen its french fries, Frizzle angrily ran off. It's probably best to follow and see what's happening.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薯条兽找到了团三郎的巢穴，两只歧骸之间的矛盾一触即发……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Frizzle has found Danzaburou's lair, and the tension between the two Oddities is about to explode…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 事情顺利解决了，但薯条兽似乎还有话想说……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The situation has been resolved smoothly, but Fry Beast seems to still have something it wants to say…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （薯条兽想去的地方……会是哪里呢？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (What kind of place would attract the Frizzle…?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （虽然能听懂歧骸的语言，可它们的想法有时候还是有些难懂啊。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Even though I can understand what oddities are saying, their way of thinking can still be pretty hard to figure out sometimes.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （如果是塔吉多想去的地方，倒是大概能猜到……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (If it was Taygedo… I could probably have a better guess…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随薯条兽，前往它想去的地方吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow Frizzle to the place it wants to go.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Clicky</> to shop for a gift

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （薯条兽看上去好像很寂寞。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (The Frizzle looks like it's feeling lonely.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （或许……为它送上一份临别礼物，能让它打起精神？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Maybe… if I give it a parting gift, that might lift its spirits?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （嗯，去附近的咔叽玛看看吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Hmm, I should check out the Clicky store nearby.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 如果给留恋海特洛的薯条兽准备一份有意义的告别赠礼，它应该会开心吧？不知道附近的咔叽玛里有没有合适的礼物……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: If I prepare a meaningful farewell gift for this Frizzle, who's so reluctant to leave Hethereau, it should make it happy, right? I wonder if there are any suitable gifts at the nearby Clicky…

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Sota, the tofu shop owner, seems troubled. Let's ask him what's wrong.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店主把打包好的豆腐放进了后备箱。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The shopkeeper placed the packaged tofu in the trunk.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 满载新鲜的豆腐，你发动了引擎。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: With the car loaded with fresh tofu, you start the engine.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （好了，尽快把豆腐送过去吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Alright, I'd better deliver this tofu as quickly as possible.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （要注意尽量开平稳些……毕竟豆腐易碎，这又是店主的爱车。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I should try to drive as smoothly as possible… after all, tofu is delicate, and this is the owner's prized car.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 家庭餐厅「食为天」急需鲜豆腐，快把货物送过去吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Food First urgently needs fresh tofu! Better deliver the goods quickly.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「食为天」的店员苍耳在路边焦急地等待着豆腐送达。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Xanthium, a staff member at Food First, waits anxiously by the roadside for the tofu delivery.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 为方便卸货，苍耳请求你把车停到仓库门口……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: To make unloading easier, Xanthium asks me to park the car at the warehouse entrance…

Description.LocalizedString: Park the vehicle at designated location

PanelDescription.SourceString: 是时候展现真正的技术了！把载有豆腐的车辆小心地停到卸货区吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time for a true display of skill! Carefully park the vehicle in the unloading zone.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 顺利地把车辆停进了卸货区，苍耳非常感谢你的帮助。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time to unload! Xanthium is very grateful for the help.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 豆腐已经平安交付到客户手上，现在回去向店主交差吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The tofu has been safely delivered. Time to head back and report to the shopkeeper.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 车上已经没有易碎的豆腐了，或许可以更自在地驰骋一番……当然还是要时刻注意交通安全。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's no tofu in the car anymore, so I can drive a bit more freely now… though I should still keep road safety in mind at all times.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哟，辛苦啦！给你准备了一份我最拿手的炸豆腐，趁热吃吧！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hey there, nice work! I've prepared some of my specialty fried tofu for you—dig in while it's hot!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 豆腐店店主速太已经等候多时了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Sota, the tofu shop owner, has been waiting for me for quite some time.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 桌上备好了一份热气腾腾的炸豆腐，赶快尝尝吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A steaming plate of Fried Tofu has been prepared on the table. Time to dig in!

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>【交互】打包豆腐
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: [Interactive] Packing Tofu

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不是所有好豆都来自蔬菜屋。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Not all good beans came from the veggie shop.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 蔬菜屋店员已经备好了店主预订的豆子。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The veggie shop staff has prepared the beans ordered by the shop owner.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 取走需要的豆子，把它们运到后备箱吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Load the beans you need.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 把豆子送回豆腐店吧，店主大概等待已久了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time to deliver these beans back to the tofu shop. The owner must have been waiting for them.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这些豆子会变成香喷喷的豆腐，其中一部分就当作给你的报酬吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: These beans will be turned into some tasty tofu! Some of it will be offered as a thank you for helping out.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 还以为有多大能耐，这么一看，不就是个邋遢大叔吗！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I thought he'd be something special, but look at him—he's just some scruffy old man!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 得罪了我们老大，你完蛋了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You've messed with our boss! Now you're done for!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店门口突然传来一阵喧哗声，似乎来了一群怎么看都不像普通顾客的年轻人……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A commotion suddenly erupts outside the shop. It seems like a group of young people have arrived. No matter how you look at it, they definitely don't seem like average customers…

Description.LocalizedString: Wait for the shop owner's return from the race

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……怎么突然这么热血？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: …Why did things suddenly get so intense?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 但愿豆腐不会烧焦……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I hope the tofu doesn't burn…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店主潇洒地转身离开了。现在能做的只有两件事：等他回来，以及看好豆腐的火候。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The shop owner turned away and left. Now there are only two things to do: wait for him to return, and keep an eye on the tofu as it cooks.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店主率先回到了豆腐店。看来，这场比赛的胜负已经分明了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The shop owner was the first to return to the tofu shop. It appears the outcome of this race is already decided.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 啊哈哈……别愣着了，快上车吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ahaha… Don't just stand there, get in the car already!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 虽然完全搞不懂状况，但你好像被指定为了这个突然冒出来的新挑战者的对手。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Even though I have no idea what's going on, it seems I've been designated as the opponent for this challenger…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 事已至此，先上车吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Well, let's get in the car then.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 赛道是不远处的白尾树盘山公路。现在就前往起点吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Whitetail Ridge Road is not far from here. I should head to the starting point now.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 白杨正准备着与你一战。告知他准备的进度吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Bai Yang is preparing to race against you. Let him know how ready you are.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 倒计时结束。踩下油门，你如离弦之箭冲出起点——
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Gas, gas, gas!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 完美完赛！哈哈，胜利的滋味就是好啊！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Perfect finish! Haha, nothing beats the sweet taste of victory!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 白杨对你的实力深感钦佩，自知能力不足的他决定投入更加刻苦的练习。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deeply impressed by your skills, Bai Yang acknowledges his own shortcomings. He decides to dedicate himself to more rigorous practice.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 为了感谢你的帮助，店主决定特别请你品尝他引以为豪的新品。趁着豆腐还热乎，快尝尝看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: To thank you for your help, Sota has decided to treat you to a special sample of his proudest new creation. Let's try the tofu while it's hot.

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>【交互】打包豆腐2
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: [Interactive] Packing Tofu 2

Description.LocalizedString: Wait until the next day (<blue>10:00 AM - 06:00 PM</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店主研发的新品非常美味，或许下次可以邀请伊波恩的大家一起来。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The shop owner's new creation is absolutely delicious! Maybe we can invite people from Eibon here next time.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 收到了豆腐店店主的短信。短信内容似乎有些异样……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Just received a message from Sota, but it seems rather strange…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （不会是出什么意外了吧……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I hope nothing bad happened…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （最好还是去店里看一眼。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I should probably go check on the shop.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 豆腐店店主突然发来一条没头没尾的短信，让你放心不下。思来想去，你决定上门一探究竟。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The tofu shop owner suddenly sent a worryingly cryptic message. After thinking it over, you decided to visit the shop and find out what's going on.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到达豆腐店后，你发现有些东西似乎不太对劲……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Upon arriving at the tofu shop, something doesn't seem quite right…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店主似乎住在豆腐店附近。确认一下他是否在家吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The shop owner seems to live near the tofu shop. Let's check if he's at home.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店主看起来平安无事，但似乎在隐瞒着什么……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The shop owner appears to be safe and sound, but he seems to be hiding something…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 既然涉及异象的问题，不妨向异象管理局的朋友打听一下吧。薄荷应当很乐意和你分享一些消息。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Since this involves an Anomaly, I should reach out to my friend at the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Mint would probably be happy to share some information with me.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店主想必也想了解更多关于「别让我停下！」的信息吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The shop owner must be eager to learn more about "Don't Let Me Stop!" as well.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>convenience store</> to buy champagne

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店主建议你提前备好赛后庆功的香槟——这大概就是赛车手独有的仪式感吧？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The shop owner suggested I prepare champagne for the post-race celebration—I guess this is a special ritual unique to racers?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 谢谢惠顾，预祝您比赛顺利！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Thank you for your purchase. Best of luck with your race!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （对了，也得和薄荷说一声。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Oh, I should probably give Mint a heads-up too.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （与「别让我停下！」竞速时，不能让其他车辆被卷入。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I can't risk other vehicles getting caught up in the race.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一切准备就绪，该返回豆腐店了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Everything is ready. Time to head back to the tofu shop.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 为了不让普通人被卷入这场比赛，你需要异象管理局的帮助。还好，你有一位总会帮助你的朋友。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: To keep ordinary people from getting caught up in this race, I need help from the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Fortunately, I have a friend who's always willing to lend a hand.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一切准备就绪，该返回豆腐店了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Everything is ready. Time to head back to the tofu shop.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店主速太已经等候多时了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Sota, the tofu shop owner, has been waiting for me for quite a while.

Description.SourceString: 等待夜晚降临（<blue>第二天凌晨1点-4点</>）

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （准备都做好了，接下来就等比赛开始了。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Just waiting for the race to happen should be enough for now)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 按照你了解到的异象性质，「别让我停下！」只在午夜活动。耐心等待它的出现吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Based on what I've learned about this Anomaly, "Don't Let Me Stop!" only appears at midnight. I should wait for it to show up.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 夜幕已经降临，是时候动身了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Night has fallen. It's time to make my move.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷发来了消息，最好尽快查看一下。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint sent a message. I should check it as soon as possible.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「别让我停下！」正向你们驶来。这时，店主似乎想起了一些往事。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: "Don't Let Me Stop!" races toward us. In that moment, the shopkeeper seems to recall memories from the past.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Fully prepared and ready to go (totaling 45)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在地平线上，你已经能看到「午夜的幽灵车神」的影子。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: On the horizon, you can already see the silhouette of the "Midnight Ghost Racer".

PanelDescription.SourceString: 半透明的「异象车神」来到了起点线上——是时候终结它的传说了！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The translucent "Ghost Racer" arrives at the starting line—it's time to end its legend once and for all!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 身后的引擎声……消失了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The engine sound behind me… it's gone.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「别让我停下！」被成功泯除。现在，「新任车神」，该打开属于你的香槟了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: "Don't Let Me Stop!" has been nullified. Now, it's time for the new God Racer to pop a champagne.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「别让我停下！」已经泯除了一段时间，豆腐店的生意还是一样红火。不过，店主似乎有什么话想说……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Some time has passed since "Don't Let Me Stop!" was nullified. It seems the tofu shop's business continues to thrive! However, it seems the shopkeeper has something on his mind…

QuestName.LocalizedString: [Epilogue] A Conversation with the Store Manager

Description.LocalizedString: [Epilogue] A Conversation with the Store Manager

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>【后日谈】和店长对话
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: [Epilogue] A Conversation with the Store Manager

QuestName.LocalizedString: Let's Get Some Ice Cream Together!

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>伊波恩门口</>与<blue>薄荷</>碰面
Description.LocalizedString: Meet with <blue>Mint</> at the <blue>Entrance of Eibon</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷带来了新品冰淇淋，去伊波恩门口与她碰面吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint has brought new ice cream flavors. Go meet her at the Entrance of Eibon.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>异象管理局大厅</>与<blue>薄荷</>碰面

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷因为没通过考试留在办公室补课，看来今天只能去管理局找她了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint is staying at the office for extra lessons because she failed her exam. Looks like I'll have to go to the Bureau for her today.

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Long Path to the Office

Description.SourceString: 跟随<blue>薄荷</>前往<blue>办公室门口</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 可可，跟我来吧！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Come on, Coco! Follow me!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟着薄荷前往她的办公室吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow Mint to her office.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟着薄荷进入她的办公室吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Enter Mint's office.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷很高兴你能来办公室陪她，也很欢迎你参观她的工位。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint is happy that you came to keep her company at the office and welcomes you to check out her workspace.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Taking an Exam Based on Luck?

Description.SourceString: 询问<blue>薄荷</>与考试相关的问题

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看到薄荷工位上的护身符和骰子，你感到有些疑惑……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You're a bit puzzled by the talismans and dice on Mint's desk…

PanelDescription.SourceString: <!>离开薄荷办公室
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Leaving the Mint Office

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷带来了一些香氛喷雾，在伊波恩迎接她吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Mint has brought some scented sprays. Go meet her at Eibon.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在周围闲逛后，薄荷似乎闻到了许多熟悉的气味，去和她聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After wandering around for a while, Mint seems to have picked up on some familiar scents. Go have a chat with her.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>伊波恩</>与<blue>娜娜莉</>交谈

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉邀请你一起去采购家族信物，去伊波恩找她吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally has invited you to go shopping for family tokens together. Go find her at Eibon.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>集山忘野花店</>与<blue>娜娜莉</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Hillside Blooms Florist</> and talk to <blue>Nanally</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 先去「集山忘野」看看吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let's check out Hillside Blooms first.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 花店啊……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The flower shop…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去花店看看有没有合适的信物吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's check the flower shop for a suitable token.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>二手电器铺</>与<blue>娜娜莉</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>used electronics</> shop and talk to <blue>Nanally</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 或许……去二手电器铺？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Or maybe… the used electronics store?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这种地方真的会有适合做信物的东西吗……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm not sure if this is the best place to look for a token…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 反正就在附近，先去看看嘛。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's right around here, so let's just go take a look!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 二手电器铺里会有合适的信物吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Would the used electronics shop have a suitable token?

QuestName.LocalizedString: Let's Use Pop Toys as a Token!

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>DSD潮玩店</>与<blue>娜娜莉</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>DSD POP</> and talk to <blue>Nanally</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 对了，潮玩店！那里应该有适合做信物的东西。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Oh right, the Pop Toys shop! They should have something perfect for a token.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯，至少听起来比二手电器合适……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hmm, at least that sounds more appropriate than used electronics…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 潮玩店里应该有适合做信物的东西，去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The pop toys shop should have something suitable as a token! Let's go check it out.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>伊波恩后院</>与<blue>娜娜莉</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Eibon's backyard</> and talk to <blue>Nanally</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉邀请你一起看一部神秘恐怖电影，去伊波恩后院找她吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally has invited you to watch a mysterious horror movie with her. Meet her in Eibon's backyard.

Description.SourceString: 前往指定地点寻找<blue>娜娜莉</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the designated location to find <blue>Nanally</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉有急事要拜托你，根据她发来的定位去找她吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally has an urgent matter, and needs your help. Follow the coordinates she sent and go find her.

Description.SourceString: 跟随<blue>娜娜莉</>前往指定地点

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉神神秘秘地将你带进巷子里……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally mysteriously leads you into an alleyway…

Description.SourceString: 查看<blue>阿德勒</>发来的信息

PanelDescription.SourceString: 阿德勒发来消息……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Adler sent a message…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>白鲸书店</>寻找<blue>埃德嘉</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 把会员卡送到埃德嘉手上吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deliver the membership card to Edgar.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>书店二楼</>寻找<blue>埃德嘉</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>second floor of the bookstore</> and find <blue>Edgar</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 以埃德嘉的性格……他应该会待在更安静的二楼吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Knowing Edgar's personality… he's probably on the quieter second floor.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去二楼找找埃德嘉吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's look for Edgar on the second floor.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将会员卡交给埃德嘉，顺便和他聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Give the membership card to Edgar and have a little chat with him.

QuestName.LocalizedString: About the Puzzling Fish Tank Wall…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>月亮湾</>寻找<blue>埃德嘉</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去「月亮湾」门口找埃德嘉吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's go find Edgar at the entrance to Luna Bay.

Description.SourceString: 进入<blue>月亮湾</>与<blue>埃德嘉</>交谈

PanelDescription.SourceString: 陪埃德嘉进店，鼓励他问出心中的疑惑吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go into the store with Edgar and encourage him to ask about what's on his mind.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>伊波恩二楼</>寻找<blue>埃德嘉</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>second floor of Eibon</> and find <blue>Edgar</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去伊波恩二楼，和埃德嘉一起看电影吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's go to the second floor of Eibon and watch a movie with Edgar.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和埃德嘉交流观影后的感想……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Share thoughts with Edgar after watching the movie…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>奶茶店</>与<blue>达芙蒂尔</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>bubble tea shop</> and talk to <blue>Daffodill</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔邀请你喝奶茶，去伊波恩附近的「抽风猫」奶茶店找她吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Daffodill has invited you for bubble tea. Go find her at the Crazy Cat near Eibon.

Description.SourceString: 在<blue>傍晚</>前往<blue>集山忘野花店</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Hillside Blooms Florist</> in the <blue>evening</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等到傍晚的时候，去花店外与达芙蒂尔碰面吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wait until evening, then meet Daffodill outside the flower shop.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Look for Lily of the Valley…

Description.SourceString: 陪<blue>达芙蒂尔</>在花店内寻找花朵
Description.LocalizedString: Help <blue>Daffodill</> look for flowers inside the flower shop

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 鉴定师。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Appraiser.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我来了，进去看看吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm here. Let's go in and take a look.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 陪达芙蒂尔一起，在众多种类的花朵中，寻找她记忆中的那一种……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Accompany Daffodill as she searches through many different types of flowers for the one from her memory…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 花店里没有达芙蒂尔想找的花。再和达芙蒂尔聊聊，或许能有头绪？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The flower shop doesn't have the flower Daffodill is looking for. Chat with Daffodill some more, maybe you'll find a clue?

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>离伊波恩最近的药店</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>pharmacy closest to Eibon</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 看起来，是店长在担心，达芙蒂尔出去了很久还没回来……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It seems the owner is worried that Daffodill's been gone for a long time without returning…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 她应该是去买解酒药了，去附近的药店找找吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: She's probably gone to buy a hangover remedy. Let's check the pharmacy nearby.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔应该是去买解酒药了，先去最近的药店找找吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Daffodill probably went to buy some hangover medicine. Let's check the nearby pharmacy.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 伊波恩附近的药店，也就只有这一家了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: There's only this one pharmacy around Eibon.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 走进店里找找达芙蒂尔……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's go into the store and look for Daffodill…

Description.SourceString: 询问<blue>店员</>有关达芙蒂尔的去向

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……不在吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: …Not here?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 问问店员有没有见过达芙蒂尔吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I should ask the staff if they've seen Daffodill.

Description.SourceString: 思考<blue>达芙蒂尔</>可能的<blue>去向</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 离这里最近的药店……是在火炬木大道附近。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The nearest pharmacy… is around Torchwood Avenue.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 想想达芙蒂尔可能会去往哪里……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let me think about where Daffodill might have gone…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>火炬木大道</>的<blue>竹本清源</>寻找<blue>达芙蒂尔</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Bamboo Pharmacy</> on <blue>Torchwood Avenue</> to find <blue>Daffodill</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 时间不早了，赶紧去那里看看吧……等天黑了就更难找人了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's getting late. I should hurry over there… It'll be even harder to find anyone once it gets dark.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 离这里最近的药店在火炬木大道附近，说不定达芙蒂尔正在那里。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The nearest pharmacy is near Torchwood Avenue. Maybe Daffodill is there.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 终于在附近的路边找到了达芙蒂尔……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Finally found Daffodill by the roadside nearby…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 时间不早了，和达芙蒂尔一起回去吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's getting late. Let's go back together with Daffodill.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 面对灯火通明的夜色，达芙蒂尔似乎有话想说……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Facing the brightly lit night, Daffodill seems to have something she wants to say…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>异象管理局</>的<blue>休息区</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Bureau of Anomaly Control</>'s <blue>rest area</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往异象管理局的休息区，寻找传说中的「狗狗咖啡厅」。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to the Bureau of Anomaly Control's rest area and find the "dog cafe" people are talking about.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Hair Care Is No Small Matter!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 翳正在叮咚怪咖所选购毛发护理产品……去凑个热闹吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Skia is shopping for hair care products at Jingle Wrangle… Go join in on the fun!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 客、客人对不起……我我我……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: C-customer, I'm sorry… I I I…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你先冷静一下……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Just calm down for a moment…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 翳似乎正在和叮咚怪咖所的店长说些什么，两人都有些为难……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Skia seems to be discussing something with the owner of Jingle Wrangle, and both of them look troubled…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 为了商谈委托事宜，翳直接赶到了伊波恩……去和他聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: To discuss commission matters, Skia came directly to Eibon… Go have a chat with him.

Description.SourceString: 在<blue>阿普斯酒吧</>附近与翳汇合
Description.LocalizedString: Meet up with Skia near <blue>A.R.P.T.S Bar</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 翳那位「道上」的故友正在阿普斯酒吧等待……先去那里与翳汇合吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Skia's old friend from the streets is waiting at A.R.P.T.S Bar… Go meet up with Skia there first.

Description.SourceString: 陪同翳前往<blue>阿普斯酒吧</>赴约
Description.LocalizedString: Accompany Skia to <blue>A.R.P.T.S Bar</> for the meeting

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一切准备就绪，与翳一同赴约吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Everything is ready. Time to show up with Skia.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 旧事与回忆一样难缠。深夜的吧台已恭候多时，故人是敌是友，不得而知……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Old matters are just as persistent as memories. The late-night bar counter has been waiting patiently, but whether this old acquaintance is friend or foe remains unknown…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 接到了哈尼娅发来的「紧急求援」。在捣蛋鬼们被九原发现之前，快赶去斯特利速递吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Received an emergency call for help from Haniel. Let's hurry to Sterry Express before Jiuyuan finds those troublemakers.

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>哈尼娅和伊里卡</>对话

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （咳咳，好浓郁的香气……甚至有些呛人。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Cough, cough… what a strong fragrance… it's almost overwhelming.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅和伊里卡正在一如既往地吵吵嚷嚷……总之先打断他们吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel and Illica are bickering as usual… Guess I should interrupt them.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 两张电影票，一辆雷加利亚，听上去再完美不过。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Two movie tickets, one Regalia, sounds absolutely perfect.

QuestName.LocalizedString: There Is Always Only One Truth!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 无论何时何地，她和她的车都是焦点。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: No matter when or where, she and her car are always the center of attention.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 九原已在约定地点等待。准备好开启这段随性而至的短途兜风之旅了吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Jiuyuan is waiting at the agreed meeting spot. Ready to embark on this spontaneous little joyride?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 九原选择的目的地会有什么风景……在抵达之前，保持期待吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What kind of scenery will Jiuyuan's chosen destination offer…? Until we arrive, I'll keep my expectations high.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 风儿被雷加利亚抛在身后。坐在九原的副驾驶座上，和她一同驶往目的地吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The wind is left trailing behind the Regalia… Sit in the passenger seat of Jiuyuan's car, and head to the destination together.

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Road Stretches Toward Faraway Places

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 说来，鉴定师也已经在海特洛生活了一段时间了吧。现在适应得怎么样？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, you've been living in Hethereau for a while now, haven't you, Appraiser? How are you adjusting now?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯，已经习惯了。海特洛是一座很包容的城市，不会让人有「客人」的感觉。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Yeah, I'm used to it now. Hethereau is a very welcoming city. It doesn't make you feel like an outsider.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 真像是你会说出来的话啊。呵呵……就像刚破壳的雏鸟似的。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That sounds exactly like something you'd say. Hehe… just like a newly hatched young bird.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 雏鸟？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: A young bird?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 懵懂的幼鸟，往往会把拥有的最初一个居所当做真正的「家」。对你而言，海特洛大概就是这样的地方吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Naive young birds often mistake their very first nest for their true home. For you, Hethereau is probably that kind of place.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （九原小姐……果然知道我没有过去记忆的事吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Miss Jiuyuan… she's figured out I have memory loss, hasn't she?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （真是什么都瞒不过她的眼睛……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Nothing gets past those eyes of hers…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 悠闲的行车过程中，九原似乎想聊些什么……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: During the leisurely drive, Jiuyuan seems like she wants to chat about something…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 到啦。嗯……再走近些吧，跟我来。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We're here. Hmm… let's get a bit closer. Follow me.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这里是……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: This place is…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 海滨公路上，九原停下了车。跟上她的脚步，去离海更近的地方吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: On the coastal highway, Jiuyuan stopped the car. Follow in her footsteps and head to a place even closer to the ocean.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 望着遥远的海平线，九原似乎若有所思。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Gazing at the distant horizon, Jiuyuan seems lost in thought.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 小吱正在和薯条兽对峙……等等，薯条兽？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Chiz is squaring off with Frizzle… wait, Frizzle?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 休息日就该好好享受，别让小吱久等了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You should really make the most of your day off… don't keep Chiz waiting.

Description.SourceString: 跟随<blue>小吱</>前往<blue>竹本清源</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 健康是第一要义，伊波恩应该不缺吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Health comes first; that's one thing Eibon isn't short on…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不知道该不该说不愧是粉爪银行的经理吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I don't know if I should say this… It's no wonder—you're the manager of Pink Paws Bank, after all...

QuestName.LocalizedString: Second Stop: Crazy Cat Milk Tea

Description.SourceString: 跟随<blue>小吱</>前往<blue>抽风猫奶茶店</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 逛街，果然就应该配一杯超美味的奶茶啊！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Shopping definitely calls for a super-tasty cup of milk tea!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 休息日和奶茶最配了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: No better combo than a day off and delicious milk tea!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 是一个关于未来的约定。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's a promise about the future.

Description.SourceString: 跟随<blue>小吱</>前往<blue>集山忘野</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 满天星的花语是……小吱。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Baby's breath means… Chiz.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Not Ready to Part Ways Yet

PanelDescription.SourceString: 那么，就让今天的约会更加圆满一点吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Alright, let's make today's date even better.

Description.SourceString: 跟随<blue>小吱</>前往<blue>上晴塔餐厅</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 今天的落日，真美啊。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The sunset is really beautiful today.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 来自小吱的深夜邀约，希望不会喝太多。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Chiz has invited me for a late night, hopefully we won't drink too much.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 头晕晕的，怎么已经回到伊波恩了？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: My head's spinning… how am I already back in Eibon?

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Morning already…?)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 是小吱的短信……果然下次还是不能喝这么多了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's a message from Chiz… Yeah, I really shouldn't drink that much next time.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 钨丝先生说故事是需要等待的，耐心点再等等吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Tungsten said that stories require patience. I should wait a little longer.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （不知道钨丝先生准备的怎么样了，有时间过去看看吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I wonder how Tungsten's preparations are going. I should take a look when I can.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不知道钨丝先生准备的怎么样了，去金苹果藏馆找他吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I wonder how Tungsten's preparations are going. I should go find him at the Gold Apple Collection Hall.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一盏小小的灯里竟然有一个这么大的异象空间，就算是第二次进入也觉得很奇妙啊。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's incredible that such a huge Anomalous Realm exists inside a tiny lamp. Even visiting for the second time, it still feels so magical.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 好久不见钨丝先生，和他聊聊近况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's been a while since I last saw Tungsten. I should catch up with him.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来这次的故事很复杂，做好准备的话，就离开展厅吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Looks like this story is going to be complicated. Once I'm ready, I should leave the showroom.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这次的故事又会遇见什么人呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I wonder who I'll meet in this story.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 直接无视的话似乎不太礼貌，还是上去问问吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems a bit rude to just ignore them. I should go over and ask.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 生面孔？来，来这边！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: New face? Come on, over here!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一位看起来有些潦倒的中年人，难道是遇到了什么难题吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A middle-aged man looking a bit down on his luck… Could he have run into some kind of trouble?

Description.SourceString: 查看<blue>「躺着不动的迦楼罗」</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 仔细看看周围吧，或许能发现什么线索。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's take a closer look around. Maybe I can find some clues.

ObjectivesInfo.ObjectiveTips: 【对话】里·配合围观群众的拍摄要求

PanelDescription.SourceString: 粉丝群体有些太热情了，和他们合照吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: These fans are a bit too enthusiastic. Let's take a photo with them.

ObjectivesInfo.ObjectiveTips: 【Tips】表·回到表世界主角内心独白

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （光辉的光辉事迹……原来是这个意思吗？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Clarion's glory days… Is this what he meant?)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 视角变回来了，刚刚的一切是光辉的过去吗？整理一下思绪吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: My perspective has returned. Was all of that Clarion's past? Let me gather my thoughts.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 光辉吹嘘的原来就是这件事吗？再仔细问问他吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So this is what Clarion was bragging about? Let me ask him more about it.

ObjectivesInfo.ObjectiveTips: 【对话】表·广场阿伟的单人演讲

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>奥罗拉广场</>听光辉的个人发布会
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Aurora Plaza</> to attend Clarion's announcement

PanelDescription.SourceString: 原来「个人」发布会的意思是只有「一个人」吗……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So a "one-man" announcement literally means just one person…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （看来光辉和迦楼罗的合作很顺利啊……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (…Looks like their plan is going well.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 显然光辉和迦楼罗的合作事业非常成功，整理下思绪吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Clearly, the partnership between Clarion and Garuda has been a huge success. Time to gather my thoughts.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在闪烁的聚光灯下，光辉已经变成了他期望的样子吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Under the flashing spotlights, has Clarion become the person he always wanted to be?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 光辉的情绪不太对，后面发生了什么？跟上去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Something seems off with Clarion. What happened back there? I should follow and check on him.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 光辉一直在敲门，是发生了什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Clarion keeps knocking on the door. Did something happen?

QuestName.LocalizedString: S111317_QuestName//Dialogue: Ura - Wei Talks to Himself at Home

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: S111317_QuestPanel//

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来光辉和迦楼罗的合作出现了一些问题，在四周看看有没有什么线索吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems there's been some trouble between Clarion and Garuda. Let's look around for clues.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 电话响了，来电人是……暗火。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The phone's ringing. The caller is… Nox.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （光辉的状态有点不对劲，他准备做什么……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (There's something wrong with Clarion… What's going on?)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 愚蠢的合作伙伴只会拖后腿，或许要考虑一些新的方式了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Foolish partners only hold you back. Perhaps it's time to consider a new approach.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 光辉似乎做下了一个不得了的决定，问问他要干什么。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Clarion seems to have made a serious decision. Let's ask him what he's planning to do.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 光辉已经陷在过去中了，他口中的那个地方一定很重要，去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Clarion is lost in the past. The place he mentioned must be important. Let's go check it out.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这么破败的地方真的适合打卡吗？光辉到底是什么意思？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Is a run-down place like this really worth checking out? What is Clarion getting at?

Description.SourceString: 击败<blue>废弃工地门口的迦楼罗</>
Description.LocalizedString: Defeat <blue>Garuda at the Abandoned Construction Site Entrance</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 总觉得有什么不好的事情要发生了，干脆利落地解决敌人吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I have a bad feeling about this. Let's take care of these enemies quickly.

Description.SourceString: 击败<blue>废弃工地一楼的迦楼罗</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 既然她急着逃跑，为什么还要把小狗带来码头呢？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Why did the criminal bring the dogs along if she wanted to escape?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 其实她是想带着小狗们一起逃走的。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: She wanted to take the dogs along on her escape.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 也是因为这个，她才会被抓住。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: And that is how she got caught in the end.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 要是她一个人逃走，我根本就来不及发现。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: If she tried to escape alone, I couldn't have found out.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 她真的很爱它们啊……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: She must have really loved them…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你是不是想说，这个人好像也没那么坏？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Are you going to tell me that she's not that bad of a criminal?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 真红的收藏似乎各有特别之处，有一些尤其让人感兴趣……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Shinku's collections are all very unique. Some of them particularly pique your interest…

Description.SourceString: 和<blue>真红</>约好下次继续听她介绍收藏
Description.LocalizedString: Tell <blue>Shinku</> you'll listen to her talk about the rest of her collections

PanelDescription.SourceString: 听真红讲述这些收藏背后的故事入了迷，转眼间就到了告别的时候了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Shinku lost track of time talking about the stories of her collections. It's already time to leave.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和真红约好出去玩，到愿木坡和她会合吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You have a date with Shinku. Meet her at Yuanmu Hill!

Description.LocalizedString: Make a wish at the <blue>Fortune Shade</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 今天来到愿木坡的观光客似乎比以往还要多了不少——总之，去许愿吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There are more tourists at Yuanmu Hill than usual. Anyway, go make a wish!

Description.LocalizedString: Talk a stroll with <blue>Shinku</> on the Cherry Blossom Path

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这下跟你的约定也兑现了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: There, I've kept my promise.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那个礼物的约定吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The promise about my gift?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是啊，后续像这张照片这样的东西会越来越多吧，那些收藏慢慢地就会变成我和你，和朋友们留下的回忆的集合。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: From now on, we'll have more things like this picture. One by one, the mementos will become a trove of memories shared by you, me, and our friends.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 或许这样的故事才是最珍贵的宝藏。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: And the stories behind them, perhaps are the most precious treasure.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……人开始多起来了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: …It's getting crowded.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 毕竟就算没有「愿望更容易实现」的传闻，也不枉来一趟呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Even if wishes weren't more likely to come true today, it was time well-spent.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 啧，本来路就不算宽敞，倒是给我好好靠右走啊，这些观光客。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Tch, these tourists. The road's already narrow enough. Why don't they stay on the right side like they should?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……要是走散了就不好了，对吧？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We don't want to get separated in the crowd… do we?
Hmm? I guess we don't?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 真没办法……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 愿木坡的樱花道，作为这次邀约的收尾再恰当不过了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Blossom Path is the cherry on the top for this date!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 真红似乎也很开心，希望和今天一样愉快又不会重复的故事在她的收藏里越来越多……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Looks like Shinku also had a good time. Hopefully, her collection keeps filling up with more stories as fun and unique as today's…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>伊波恩后院</>与<blue>达芙蒂尔</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Eibon's backyard</> and talk to <blue>Daffodill</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔想谈谈关于残虹异能的事，去伊波恩后院见她吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Daffodill wants to talk to you about Zankou's powers. Meet her at Eibon's backyard.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往伊波恩的二楼，等待达芙蒂尔和浔抵达。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to Eibon 2F and wait for Daffodill and Hotori.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Raindrop Court</> and talk to <blue>Hotori</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 浔突然发来了共饮的邀请，去落雨庭见见她吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hotori asked you to have a drink. Meet her at the Raindrop Court.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>异象管理局</>与<blue>奈丽</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Bureau</> and talk to <blue>Nelly</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 审讯残虹的日子到了，去异象管理局和奈丽了解情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Zankou is being interrogated today. Go to Nelly at the Bureau for updates.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 虽然只是一场发生在局长办公室的简短审讯，但异象管理局，尤克阿什庭和格赫罗斯岛都参与其中。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's just a brief interrogation in the Director's office, but you find representatives from the BAC, Yggash Court, and Ghroth Island.

Description.SourceString: 与众人交流审讯的结果
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to people about the interrogation

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这是一个秘密，一场漫长的煎熬……或许，也可能是一种「馈赠」？你说呢，鉴定师？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A secret, a long and arduous torture… or maybe even a gift? What do you say, Appraiser?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 海月似乎正在沉思……去和她聊一聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Aurelia seems lost in thought… Go talk to her.

Description.LocalizedString: Accept the milk tea from <blue>T. Kat</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 海月……一直在看手机啊。是有工作消息吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Aurelia… you've been looking at your phone a lot. Is it work-related?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 没有没有，只是在查地图。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: No, no—I'm just checking the map.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 地图？我们要去什么地方吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: A map? Are we trying to find something?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 啊哈哈……只是我方向感太差，怕带你走错路……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ahaha… No, I'm just terrible with directions, so I was worried I'd lead you the wrong way…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和海月一起走在玉饼街上，偶尔会得到一些「意外收获」。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A walk down Tamamochi Street with Aurelia might bring a pleasant surprise.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 把玉饼街从头到尾逛了个遍，差不多可以向海月交差了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You've explored Tamamochi Street from end to end. Time to check in with Aurelia.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 如约来到玉饼街，却发现有过一面之缘的人们正在争执。发生什么事了？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You arrived at Tamamochi Street as promised, only to find some familiar faces arguing. What's going on?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 收到海月的邀请后，你欣然赴约。在热闹的夜市里，首先要找到海月的身影……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You happily accepted Aurelia's invitation. Now to find her amid the bustling night market…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 想吃点什么？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: What do you want to eat?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯……一时间想不出来啊。感觉每一家都很美味……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Mm… I can't decide. Everything looks delicious…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那要不要先去尝尝抽风猫和Myosotis合作推出的鲜果茶？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: How about we try the fresh fruit tea from Crazy Cat and Myosotis first?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 啊，这个主意不错！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ah, that's a great idea!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 天下没有不散的筵席，再美好的盛会也终会落幕。不过至少这个夜晚，你们留下了愉快的回忆。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Even the best celebrations must come to an end. Still, you made some wonderful memories together tonight.

Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the <blue>anxious researcher</> by the road

Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the <blue>anxious researcher</> by the road

PanelDescription.SourceString: 就算是迈达斯科技的研究员也要为自己的毕业课题烦恼，路过的好心人啊，请伸出援手吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Even a Midas Technologies researcher has to worry about his graduation project. Kind passerby, lend him a hand.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 终于完成课题的毕业非常喜悦，但看起来他愉快的原因并不是论文完成？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Grad is thrilled to have finally finished his project, but it seems his paper isn't the real reason he's so happy.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 那边等着的是……九原小姐？去打个招呼吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Is that… Jiuyuan waiting there? I should greet her.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>卡佩大酒店</>与<blue>神秘人</>对话
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>The Kapé</> and talk to the <blue>Mystery Person</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 既然是九原小姐带来的情报，值得一探究竟，去问问那位接头人吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Jiuyuan's intel must be worth looking into. Go ask the contact person.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 绵绵们口中的「怪东西」究竟是……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What is this "strange thing" the Fuzzies are talking about…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 比「怪东西」更先一步映入眼帘的，是一群怪物。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Before you find the strange thing, a group of monsters appears before you.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将周围的怪物都打倒吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Defeat all the monsters around you!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 打败怪物后，可以近距离地观察这个飞船似的大家伙了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Now that you've defeated the monsters, you can approach and observe this big thing that looks like a flying ship…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 伊洛伊似乎有些事要回绵绵村，去和她会合吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Iroi went back to the Fuzzy Village for something. Go find her.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 要把真相告诉咩丁吗？又或许，他早就知道自己之后要面对什么……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Should you tell Maaartin the truth? Or does he already know what is to come…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 按咩丁给定的点位，布设炸药。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow Maaartin's instructions to place the dynamite.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 要不要救他呢？不如，就让他别回去了吧~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Should we save him? Why don't we keep him in this timeline?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 可如果他不回去，整个绵绵村都会被毁掉的。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: But if he doesn't go back, the entire Fuzzy Village will be burned to the ground.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 按照最朴素的逻辑，当然是整个绵绵村比较重要啦。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: By the simplest logic, of course the whole Fuzzy Village matters more.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不过现在看来，一个真实可感的人，和一大群遥远不具体的人相比，果然还是不一样啊……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: But we're talking about someone we actually know here. A distant and faceless crowd doesn't even compare.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哦不，不是「人」，是「绵」~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Oh, not "someone" but "some Fuzzy."

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 有没有办法能把咩丁和绵绵村都救下来……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Is there a way to save both Maaartin and the village?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……只要火山不喷发就行了……但又要怎么让火山不喷发呢？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We can if the volcano doesn't erupt… but how are we going to stop it?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯~听起来很简单哦！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Mhm. That sounds pretty easy to me!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 莫非伊洛伊有办法？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Iroi, you have a way to stop it?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 按咩丁给定的点位，布设炸药。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow Maaartin's instructions to place the dynamite.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 按咩丁给定的点位，布设炸药。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow Maaartin's instructions to place the dynamite.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 还剩下最后一个炸药点位……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Once last location for the dynamite…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 唔——鉴定师，前面有怪物！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Umm, Appraiser, there's a monster!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这些怪物真是出现得「恰到好处」。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: These monsters appear just at the right time.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 按咩丁给定的点位，布设炸药。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow Maaartin's instructions to place the dynamite.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 完成啦！回去找咩丁~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Tada! Let's go back to Maaartin!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 炸药都布设完成了，回去和咩丁会合吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The dynamite are all placed. Go back to Maaartin.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 结局皆大欢喜，却又有些奇怪……再和伊洛伊聊聊刚才的事吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You got a happy but… strange ending? Talk to Iroi about what just happened.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 绵绵小队在火山冒险，好像遇到了什么难题……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A group of Fuzzy adventurers seems to have run into trouble at the volcano…

Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the group of <blue>Adventurer Fuzzies</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 把食材交付给冒险绵，或许还可以……一起吃大餐！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: If you provide ingredients to the Adventurer Fuzzies and let them cook… maybe they'll offer you to dine together!

Description.LocalizedString: Defeat the <blue>Stone Plate</> and the <blue>Golden Plate </>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 啊，稀有的铠甲出现了！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Aha! A rare plate just dropped!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 没有得到战利品，该怎么告诉收藏绵呢……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You didn't get any spoils. How are you going to tell that to the Collector Fuzzy…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 把「礼物」交付给川川绵吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Deliver the gift to Chocho Fuzzy.
