BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 按村长爷爷的说法，北方的这座古堡就有英雄曾经活跃过的传说咩。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: According to the Elder Fuzzy, there's a legendary tale that heroes once roamed this ancient castle up north, baa.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 既然答应了巫师绵，就去她提到的那座古堡看看吧，但愿她从村长绵那里听来的消息没出差错……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Since you agreed to help the Wizard Fuzzy, go ahead and check out the castle. Let's hope the intel she got from the Elder Fuzzy is accurate…

Description.SourceString: 赶跑在古堡里涂鸦的<blue>暗黑咩</>
Description.LocalizedString: Chase away the <blue>Shadow Fuzzies</> vandalizing the castle

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一路穿越各种棘手怪物的阻挠抵达了目的地，居然有一群邪恶的绵绵在这里乱涂乱画……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You stormed through different groups of difficult monsters and arrived at your destination, only to find that a bunch of evil Fuzzies are vandalizing the place…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 都教训完啦！这些邪恶的绵绵居然在这么重要的地方乱涂乱画！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We've taught them all a lesson! Those evil Fuzzies were vandalizing a landmark!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 赶快回去把这个好消息告诉巫师绵吧！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hurry back and tell Wizard Fuzzy the good news!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 回到绵绵村把好消息告诉巫师绵吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Bring the good news to the Wizard Fuzzy at the village

PanelDescription.SourceString: 解决了手边的任务，就去古堡看看巫师绵有没有准备好唤醒古代的英雄吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Now that you solved the quest, go to the castle to check whether the Wizard Fuzzy is prepared to summon the ancient hero.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 巫师绵似乎在为古堡里的涂鸦困扰，她有点够不着暗黑咩画在高处的那些……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Wizard Fuzzy seems to be troubled by the graffiti in the castle. She can't quite reach those left by the Shadow Fuzzies at higher places…

ObjectivesInfo.ObjectiveTips: <!>涂鸦清理完成，向巫师绵汇报

PanelDescription.SourceString: 清理完涂鸦后，这里似乎终于符合了条件，可以看巫师绵施展她的传奇魔法了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After the graffiti is cleaned, the place finally meets the requirements for the Wizard Fuzzy to cast her legendary spell.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 说到与古代英雄有关的物品或场所，能提供线索的大概只有神秘商绵了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: When it comes to items and places related to an ancient hero, the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant might be the only one who can help…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>琥珀湖</>寻找英雄遗物的线索
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Amber Syrup Lake</> to find relics of the hero

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 说起来，英雄信物的需求最近突然增加了好多呢，难道是什么行情热门的特殊时节？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, demand for hero tokens just spiked. Is there a seasonal trend, or what??

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 下了很多信物订单的，该不会是同一只绵吧……？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Think all those orders came from the same Fuzzy…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 真奇怪，脑袋里马上就冒出来一个感觉很容易上当的身影呢~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Funny, a real sucker just popped into my head.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 咩嘿嘿~这可是优质客户咩。绵很有职业操守，不会随意泄露客户的信息咩。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Baa-heehee… That's a premium customer, baa. I'm all class about keeping customer info private—I don't kiss and tell, baa.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这个奸商……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That merchant was running a racket…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 按神秘商绵的描述出发前往琥珀湖吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow the merchant's directions and head towards the Amber Syrup Lake.

Description.LocalizedString: Defeat the <blue>Fork-tailed Fox</> in the ruins

PanelDescription.SourceString: 许多怪物盘踞在琥珀湖附近的一处遗迹中不肯离去……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Many monsters have occupied ruins near the Amber Syrup Lake…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 英雄的遗物就沉睡在遗迹里……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The relic of the hero is inside the ruins…

Description.SourceString: 把触媒带给还在<blue>赤龙古堡</>等候的<blue>巫师绵</>
Description.LocalizedString: Bring the medium back to the <blue>Wizard Fuzzy</> in the <blue>Crimson Castle</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 有了与英雄因缘颇深的触媒，希望巫师绵的魔法这回能够成功……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: With a medium that has a history with the hero, the Wizard Fuzzy hopes that she could successfully cast her spell this time…

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>巫师绵</>呼唤出来的古代英雄对话
Description.LocalizedString: Speak to the ancient hero summoned by the <blue>Wizard Fuzzy</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 召唤了英雄的巫师绵晕了过去，只能先打个招呼了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Wizard Fuzzy fainted after casting her summoning spell. You'll have to great the ancient hero…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 刚才没来得及问，那只看起来很有大人物感觉的绵绵怎么披了一床棉被……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I didn't get a chance to ask earlier, but why was that big-shot Fuzzy wrapped in a quilted blanket…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那是披风啦，大笨猫！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That was a cloak, Dumcat!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 还好没问出来。要是因为口无遮拦冒犯了别人该怎么办！说不定会触发什么不妙的事件……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Good thing I didn't ask after all. If I'd offended someone with my lack of filter, I might've triggered a nasty fight…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 到时候就把薄荷交出去吧，没有人或者绵会跟笨笨的野蛮人计较啦~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: When the time comes, just hand Mint over. Nobody—human or Fuzzy—is gonna make a fuss over that silly little one.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 巫师绵不像能应付得来「狮心」绵的样子，有点放心不下。去看看她现在怎么样了吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Wizard Fuzzy doesn't seem to be able to handle the Lionheart Fuzzy. Worried, you decided to check up on her…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ——喔，有件小事余差点忘记了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: —Ah, I nearly forgot one little thing.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这个村子里，好像没有足够「摇滚」的乐器咩。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: This village appears to lack the proper instruments required to summon such a rockin' tempest.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 猜到了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I thought so…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 都帮到这个份上了，再去找找奸商吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We've already gotten this far, so let's pay another visit to the merchant.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 绵绵村里如果真的有摇滚乐的器材那也太奇怪了，还是看看神秘商绵有没有什么特别渠道吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wouldn't it be strange if the Fuzzy Village had instruments for rock music? Go see the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant for a solution…

Description.SourceString: 击败骚扰商路的<blue>暗黑咩</>
Description.LocalizedString: Defeat the <blue>Shadow Fuzzies</> disrupting trade routes

PanelDescription.SourceString: 虽然还是很难相信神秘商绵能在这个世界准备摇滚乐的乐器，但总之先保护好商路再说吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Though you can hardly believe that the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant can find rock music instruments in this world, you decided to make sure the trade routes are open…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这下没有怪物……或者绵会去骚扰神秘商绵的秘密商路了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Now, no monsters—nor Fuzzies—would interrupt the secret trade routes of the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>「狮心」绵</>的演奏场地
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Lionheart Fuzzy's</> performance venue

PanelDescription.SourceString: 神秘商绵真的弄来了整套的摇滚乐器材……然后一位古代的绵绵君主还要用它们来演奏。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant really managed to get an entire set of rock music instruments… and now, an ancient Fuzzy king is going to perform with them.

Description.SourceString: 击败乱入演奏现场的怪物
Description.LocalizedString: Defeat the monsters that appeared in the performance venue

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 看来不是错觉呢~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Looks like it wasn't my imagination after all!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「狮心」绵和巫师绵的演奏真的提供了像魔法一样的支援。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The performance by "Lionheart" Fuzzy and Wizard Fuzzy really boosted our spirits, almost like magic.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那就承蒙好意，放开手脚大干一场吧！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Then thanks for the offer—let's cut loose and go all out!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「狮心」绵和巫师绵的演奏不仅迅速成长到足以称为「演出」的水平，还吸引来了不少绵绵之外的「客人」……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Lionheart Fuzzy's and Wizard Fuzzy's skills improved so much, that their performances soon transformed from amateur levels into professional, attracting not just Fuzzies but a variety of other "guests."

PanelDescription.SourceString: 作为摇滚乐手的初次演出应该算是相当成功，「狮心」绵和巫师绵好像有话想说……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Lionheart Fuzzy and Wizard Fuzzy's first performance as rock musicians was rather successful. Looks like they have something to tell you…
